description: Get The Standard Reserve (TSR)'s reserve backing on Robinhood Chain: vault ETH balances, discovered reserve-asset holdings (unpriced today — no price source exists yet, so each comes back with eth_value null and valuation "unpriced"), and eth_backing_per_standard (vault ETH per circulating STANDARD) in two variants — excluding_pol is the conservative figure, including_pol folds total POL-controlled ETH (idle + position principal + uncollected fees) back in and is null when pol_position_basis is position_inventory_unavailable. Position STANDARD and per-range liquidity are also returned. Neither variant includes ETH held by the tax hook or fee splitter (see hook_eth_balance_raw/fee_splitter_eth_balance_raw on 1s_std_buyback_readiness) — that ETH is tax collected on trades awaiting a forwardTaxes() call, not vault-held backing. Pass history_hours to get the backing-ratio history instead of the current snapshot, or atBlock to get the backing snapshot at or before that block (ignored when history_hours is set). Fields ending in _raw are 18-decimal integers as strings; divide by 1e18 to get token amounts.

atBlock.description: Return the backing snapshot at or before this block instead of the latest one

history_hours.description: When set, return backing-ratio history for this many hours instead of the current snapshot

name: 1s_std_backing
title: TSR Reserve Backing
